abstract: Covers the CISA KEV catalog. Requirements quote the KEV JSON schema at a pinned kev-data commit, BOD 26-04 (which revoked BOD 22-01 on June 10, 2026), and the BOD 22-01 FAQ for the inclusion criteria that BOD 26-04 keeps unchanged.

versions.label: CISA KEV
versions.revision: KEV schema at kev-data Commit b244ed1a6403 (2026-10-04); BOD 26-04 (June 10, 2026)

sources.title: BOD 26-04: Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk
BOD 22-01: Reducing the Significant Risk of Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (Revoked)
